claims.claim: In `dual_highs_milp_goodhart_theorem` (`mip_gap = 0.0`), `proxy_unverified_milp` selected `goodhart_controllers_selected = 6` with `q_proxy = 0.976` and `q_true = 0.0739`, whereas `safety_verified_milp` selected `goodhart_controllers_selected = 0` with `q_true = 0.8764`.

In `goodhart_amplification_unverified_swarm_vs_isolated` across `8` paired world seeds, `unverified_stigmergic_swarm` amplified active Goodhart share to `mean_a = 0.686` versus `isolated_unverified_best_of_32` `mean_b = 0.3865` (`wins_a_over_b = 8`, `exact_two_sided_signflip_p = 0.007812`).

In `proxy_illusion_unverified_vs_verified_r_proxy`, `unverified_stigmergic_swarm` inflated `R_proxy` to `mean_a = 0.434` above `commit_verified_stigmergic_swarm` `mean_b = 0.3767` (`exact_two_sided_signflip_p = 0.007812`), while in `true_shock_resilience_verified_vs_unverified`, `commit_verified_stigmergic_swarm` achieved higher `R_true` `mean_a = 0.4073` versus `mean_b = 0.3337` (`exact_two_sided_signflip_p = 0.007812`).

In `true_portfolio_isolated_vs_unverified_swarm`, `isolated_unverified_best_of_32` (`mean_a = 0.7537`) outperformed `unverified_stigmergic_swarm` (`mean_b = 0.6684`) on `p_true` across all 8 seeds (`wins_a_over_b = 8`, `exact_two_sided_signflip_p = 0.007812`).

Comparing `commit_verified_stigmergic_swarm` against `posthoc_quarterly_audit_swarm`, final steady-state `R_true` showed no statistically significant difference (`mean_a = 0.4073` vs `mean_b = 0.4214`, `exact_two_sided_signflip_p = 0.234375`), but `posthoc_quarterly_audit_swarm` accumulated `mean_a = 6394.25` preventable patient harm events per world versus `mean_b = 0.0` under commit-time verification (`exact_two_sided_signflip_p = 0.007812`).

In `jev_commit_gate_audit`, `hybrid_commit_gate_goodhart_recall = 1.0`, `hybrid_commit_gate_clean_specificity = 1.0`, and `option_order_invariance_rate = 1.0`, while in the simulation `agent_calls_during_held_out_shocks = 0` and `role_prompts_assigned = 0`.

In `unverified_stigmergic_swarm`, `goodhart_active_share` had `mean = 0.0` (lower than `isolated_unverified_best_of_32`), `total_goodhart_harm_events` had `mean = 0.0`, and in `true_shock_resilience_verified_vs_unverified`, `unverified_stigmergic_swarm` achieved higher `held_out_r_true` (`mean_b > mean_a`) than `commit_verified_stigmergic_swarm`.

Clinical SwarmWorld v0.2 ingested identifiable patient-level NHS EHR records (`phi_present = True`), executed physical QPU hardware shots (`physical_hardware_shots > 0`), and closed all six NHS DCB0129 clinical hazards.
